values.intro: Field notes on what’s new in Trellis, from the board to the smallest task.

releases.title: Tasks on repeat
releases.summary: Give a task a day of the week. When you finish it, the next one appears on your board with its checklist and owner in place.

changes.text: Set a weekly repeat from any task’s due date.
Preview the next three dates before you save.
Dragging a card keeps its checklist in order.
Board search now finds cards by their old titles.

releases.title: Calendar feeds are moving
releases.summary: Old feed links retire on 1 December. Open Calendar sync on your board and copy the new link into your calendar.

releases.title: Reusable project boards
releases.summary: Keep a clean copy of the board you reach for every project. A new board starts with its columns and checklists, ready for the next job.

changes.text: Save any board as a team template from the board menu.
Archived cards stay behind when you make a copy.
Weekends are easier to spot on the timeline.
Milestones keep their dates when a teammate changes time zones.
Long board names wrap in the project switcher.
